data.content_ref: inline:SRC_003's failure mode for skipping is stated abstractly — 'silent corruption of the append-only record' — but its own counterconditions concede 'WorkflowReplayState.digest is not consumed by any downstream integrity check, the blast radius shrinks and this test may not deserve priority 1' and 'the failed-append path is unreachable in production due to upstream validation, the corruption scenario is theoretical.' The priority-1 ranking rests on an unproven assumption that the digest is consumed downstream and the failed-append path is reachable. The deliverable requires an ordering justified by blast radius, but this target's justification is conditional on facts it has not established, so its top rank is unsupported.
